originalSql: WITH r AS (SELECT ra.year AS year, ra.round AS round, ra.race_id AS race_id, r.driver_id AS driver_id, r.constructor_id AS ctor FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959), firsts AS (SELECT year, driver_id, ctor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY round ASC, race_id ASC) AS rn FROM r), lasts AS (SELECT year, driver_id, ctor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY round DESC, race_id DESC) AS rn FROM r), cnt AS (SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS nrounds FROM r GROUP BY year, driver_id) SELECT DISTINCT d.forename AS forename, d.surname AS surname FROM firsts f JOIN lasts l ON l.year = f.year AND l.driver_id = f.driver_id AND l.rn = 1 JOIN cnt ON cnt.year = f.year AND cnt.driver_id = f.driver_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = f.driver_id WHERE f.rn = 1 AND f.ctor = l.ctor AND cnt.nrounds >= 2 ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
